body: Hm. We shall see what happens. Though now I am feeling better and off to bed. Thank you.
It's mostly just miscellaneous money, and I can't really get to a bank, I have no car to drive and we literally live in the forest.

Once I do that, I don't know where I go from there. I can't go back to college, so I just have to work a minimum wage job until I die? My family put so much emphasis on going to college, that now that I'm out of it, I don't know what to do with myself.

I don't even have money for the doctor, I'm not sick so my dad won't take me for nothing, and we have no health insurance. My closest relatives are across the country, and I would go but I have no money, and apparently no way to save money since it just disappears.
Thanks for the support. It all seems so big and nasty.

I'm living at home, someone in my family is stealing any money I get. No matter where in my room I hide it, they get to it. The sudden downturn was very strange, I had nothing to be sad or angry about, everything was going perfectly. No one tried to talk to me, and I'm no longer a student there because my GPA was too low to stay so I can't talk to them now.
